title.narrative: Start Fund Response - Odisha Floods October 2018

description.narrative: Cyclone Titli made landfall near Gopalpur in Odisha's Ganjam district on 11 October, accompanied by wind speeds of up to 145 kmph. Local media reports indicate that approximately 6,000,000 people in 11 Odisha districts are affected. The death toll from Cyclone Titli and the subsequent floods in Odisha is 61 casualties, which is expected to rise. About 57,000 houses were completely damaged, leading the state government to seek assistance from national Pradham Mantri Awas Yojana (flagship housing scheme for below poverty line populace) (Souce: The Indian Express, October 20, 2018 6:17:48 pm). The cyclone caused heavy rainfall in the Coastal and interior regions of Odisha. The wind caused damage to kuchha houses, trees and electricity poles. The response will cover 2000 HHs with Shelter, NFI and WaSH assistance, spanning 3 Gram Panchayats, 1 Block, 39 villages, 2,000 HHs, with 4717 Women, 5283 men, of 8160 ST and 1840 SC individuals. Altogether, reaching humanitarian aid to 10,000 population. CAFOD/Caritas India has targeted the following assistance to different vulnerable groups: 1) WaSH kit to 2000 families will reach 4717 women and young girls 2) Hygiene promotion activities for 10,000 population 3) Shelter kits & NFI kits for 2,000 HHs.
